tabs.title: Understanding
tabs.description: Understand the central ideas and the people.

tabs.title: Using What You Read
tabs.description: Apply the idea in a new situation.

questions.q: Why does seeing the old square make Tomas think of writing to Robin?
choices: The shop owners ask him to contact his old classmates.
He finds a message from Robin painted on the wall.
It reminds him of their friendship and how little they have spoken since the move.
He needs permission to enter the workshop.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: What does Tomas's experience teaching the children show?
choices: Only trained mechanics are allowed to help at the workshop.
He can contribute even while he is still learning himself.
Children usually know more about repairs than adults.
Helping others is useful only when someone gives you a certificate.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: What has the workshop added to the old shoe shop?
choices: A new cinema and a large fountain in the square.
A private school for people who want to become mechanics.
A shopping centre specialising in football boots.
A space where people repair things and share memories of the area.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: Why does the story about the bicycle light make Tomas laugh?
choices: The child thinks he is an expert even though he is only beginning to learn.
The bicycle has a broken wheel as well as a light.
The workshop has accidentally received the wrong tools.
Robin used to repair the same bicycle at school.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: Why is Mrs Okafor an important person in the workshop?
choices: She decides which children are allowed to repair bicycles.
She can make every visitor agree about the old fountain.
She connects old photographs with stories about the neighbourhood.
She is the only person who remembers where the workshop is.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: Why does Tomas say Robin does not need to prepare a speech?
choices: He wants the invitation to feel easy and without pressure.
The open day will not include any visitors.
He has already prepared a speech for Robin.
Robin has never taken a photograph in the neighbourhood.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: What is the purpose of offering a video call or a later visit?
choices: The workshop has decided to cancel its open day.
Tomas wants to rebuild the connection even if travelling now is difficult.
He would rather never see Robin in person again.
A video call is needed to repair the bicycle lights.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: A friend wants to join a community project but feels inexperienced. What would Tomas likely say?
choices: Wait until you are a professional before attending.
Choose only a project in which you can earn a prize.
Avoid talking to new people at every meeting.
Start with simple tasks and learn how to help gradually.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: Robin is busy and cannot bring photographs to the open day. Which response best fits Tomas's message?
choices: Robin must bring pictures or cannot enter.
A short visit would still be welcome, and other ways to connect are possible.
Tomas will cancel the whole event.
They cannot speak again until Robin has a free weekend.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.

questions.q: What is the best way for Tomas and Robin to stop waiting for special occasions?
choices: Send only photographs of important celebrations.
Avoid discussing their new towns until the next school reunion.
Wait until both can travel before sending any messages.
Agree on a simple way to talk regularly and share their everyday lives.
questions.explanation: Tomas uses the workshop and invitation to reconnect with Robin and emphasises helping others even without special expertise.
